relations.subject: Léon Feer
relations.place: Chair of Tibetan (Bibliothèque Nationale, transferred 1865 to the École des Langues Orientales)
relations.evidence: In 1864 he was appointed to a Paris professorship, succeeding M. Foucaux in the Chair of Tibetan, originally created for the Bibliothéque Nationale, and transferred in 1865 to the Ecole des Langues Orientales.

relations.subject: Léon Feer
relations.evidence: transferred in 1865 to the Ecole des Langues Orientales

relations.subject: Léon Feer
relations.evidence: He afterwards (1869) held a lectureship in Tibetan and Mongol at the ‘Collége de France.

relations.subject: Léon Feer
relations.evidence: In 1872 M. Feer entered the Manuscript Department of the Bibliothéque Nationale. He passed from promotion to promotion to be bibliothécaire of his department

relations.subject: Léon Feer
relations.evidence: In 1900 he was appointed Conservateur-Adjoint of the great national collection.

relations.subject: Léon Feer
relations.evidence: Léon Feer’s greatest service to Pali scholarship was his edition of the ‘Samyutta-nikaya’ for the Pali Text Society. It was his last long work.

relations.subject: Léon Feer
relations.evidence: He was also an unwearied contributor to the Journal Asiatique till within a few months of his death.

relations.subject: Léon Feer
relations.evidence: was one of the oldest collaborators in the Revue de Ul’ Histoire des Religion
